scope: Read-only audit plus two requested local report artifacts. No implementation,numerical tests,compilation,network,git,archive,job or private bde54 diff access.
decision: Implement the existing paged initial_cache/decode contract on NativeLlamaLmHeadModel; reuse the current engine and caches. There is no separate model.prefill contract.

exact_interface.contract: One cache per decoder layer,shape [num_pages,page_size,2*num_kv_heads,head_dim],axes page/slot/kv_head/head_size; K/V interleaved (k0,v0,k1,v1,...). Pure allocation compatible with filter_eval_shape and hax.named_jit. Preserve explicit dtype and complete physical layout.

exact_interface.signature: decode(self, input_ids: NamedArray[position], kv_cache: ListCache[KvPageCache], batch_info: PageBatchInfo, pos_ids: NamedArray[position], *, key=None) -> tuple[NamedArray[position,Vocab], ListCache[KvPageCache]]
exact_interface.contract: Handles packed multi-sequence prefill,chunked continuation and autoregressive decode in the same method. Absolute per-sequence positions arrive from scheduler; they are not flat token offsets. Static token buffer includes invalid tail padding; only num_new_tokens prefix may update cache. Return logits for same packed capacity; valid positions are selected by engine.

caller_contracts.fact: HBM sizing calls filter_eval_shape(model.initial_cache); construction calls hax.named_jit(initial_cache,axis_resources). Named cache sizing uses logical mapping rather than solely existing array sharding (utils/jax_utils.py:545-599); cache head mapping must agree with actual explicit placement.
Both prefill and generation invoke model.decode; engine allocates pages before call,selects final prompt/query logits and samples. No second generation/scheduler loop is needed.

PageTableSpec contains num_pages/page_size only. PageBatchInfo carries page_indices,total seq_lens,cu_q_lens,num_seqs,destinations. Tokens for each sequence must be contiguous,sequence slot order need not be sorted; batch_info row index is not global sequence slot ID. Scheduler packs valid prefix and preserves token/position/slot alignment.

Old standard-Llama contract normalizes/project/RoPE,updates cache before attention,then residual+MLP/final norm and tied/untied head. Layer/cache lists are explicitly iterated because the old scanned cache path did not alias reliably.

ListCache.copy_page/reset and KvPageCache.copy_page support clone/reset. KV update donates pages; generation loop donates gen_state. New cache must replace old; no stale donated references or persistent concatenated dense cache.

sample_lm duplicates old loader and asserts old head class. lm-eval generate_until already needs same paged methods and is single-host only. Server uses same engine and re-enters mesh/axis mapping on its worker/reload threads; native explicit layout selection must reach those real callsites before claiming server support.

bounded_interface_plan: Keep raw native core Haliax-free. Add the two public methods at the existing native LM named boundary. Use existing KvPageCache/ListCache and PageBatchInfo unchanged; no new cache class or standalone native engine. Never convert native parameters into LlamaLMHeadModel or call old Llama attention/decoder math; only existing model-independent cache/ragged infrastructure is reused.

First implement/prove a named cache+ragged bridge under the native Explicit mesh. The shared reference attention already uses auto_axes with pinned output sharding (grug/attention/_core.py:288-300); use that established pattern for the small raw-array wrapper around existing cache update/ragged attention where Auto math is required,restoring explicit query/cache layouts at its outputs. Do not change all mesh axes to Auto or use a host conversion. Verify this bridge before undertaking model-wide wiring.

Use an explicit decode layout derived from existing NativeLlamaSharding: batch_axes=(),same fsdp_axis/model_axis. View packed tokens as [1,T],positions [1,T],hidden [1,T,D],so existing B/S math remains reusable and packed T is never reinterpreted as independent causal sequences. All sequence separation comes from PageBatchInfo at ragged attention. Keep packed tokens,positions,seq/page metadata replicated; head/channel dimensions remain TP-sharded. This first slice is one single-host scheduler stream,replicated over data axes,not distributed data-parallel serving.

Factor actual native QKV projection/head norm/RoPE and post-attention residual+MLP computation into small raw helpers shared by ordinary forward and decode,accepting the concrete layout. Reuse native embedding/final norm/tied-or-untied head rather than instantiating the old model. Preserve optional bias,norm and scaled-RoPE semantics through those helpers; leave training layout and forward math unchanged. Native __call__ currently binds train sharding; merely adding a B=1 dimension does not override it.

Per layer use ArrayStacked.get_layer and matching ListCache entry. From raw Q [1,T,Hq,D],reshape to named [T,Hkv,Hq/Hkv,D]; K/V to [T,Hkv,D]. Update existing cache,call existing ragged_paged_attention with sm_scale=1/sqrt(head_dim),then flatten query heads,cast attention output back to residual compute dtype and use actual native o_proj. Apply shared block residual/MLP math,then final norm/head. Return named [position,Vocab] logits and updated ListCache. Do not substitute ordinary dense attention over the packed token buffer.

Use P(None,None,model,None) cache layout [page,slot,interleaved_head,dim],replicated data/FSDP; query grouped heads use P(None,model,None,None),tokens P(None),logits P(None,model). Require native KV head count divisible by TP size so model shards contain complete K/V pairs; no splitting interleaved pairs and no silent head replication fallback. Existing FSDP storage remains; compute projections gather its dimension as native Linear already does.

Wire sample_lm through the reviewed shared loader boundary only after that contribution is available; set existing requires_explicit_mesh_axes capability before initialization,resolve inference mapping once,and replace its old-only assertion with explicit supported standard-Llama types during transition. Do not inspect or duplicate unpublished shared-loader code. Keep existing engine,sampler,request/stop/clone logic. Extend the already-existing generate_until callsite via same contract; no parallel generation API.
behavior_boundaries: Paged decode is causal only. PageBatchInfo encodes cached prefix plus current contiguous positions; arbitrary dense,bidirectional,sliding-window/segment-mask generation is not implemented by existing ragged API. Never silently reinterpret these model-family semantics.

Engine compute_dtype allocates cache only; it does not cast model weights. Loader inference compute dtype and cache dtype must be deliberately consistent; cache update currently casts K/V to page dtype. Test BF16 behavior directly and pin treatment of native upcast_attn; if mixed-Q/K/cache dtype cannot be preserved,explicitly reject that option until supported.

Do not call existing unbatched activations as a decode implementation: llama_native_lm.py:398-411 broadcasts a whole sequence across training data batch partitions,returns one replica,and has no cache. It cannot express the scheduler packed-sequence attention contract.

Initial cache mapping and runtime named ragged mapping must agree with physical native specs. Engine axis_resources is used for cache sizing/allocation but is not saved as execution context; the model boundary must make its concrete head mapping available at trace time,including sample/eval/server worker contexts.

ragged_paged_attention catches TPU kernel errors and falls back to testing reference. A result from the dispatcher does not prove TPU fast path ran. Keep CPU reference correctness and separately observed actual TPU kernel execution as distinct claims.

Sampler samples all model.Vocab rows and has no tokenizer-domain mask (layers/sampler.py:28-79; engine.py:879-881). Source/padded Vocab may exceed tokenizer length. Preserve full model rows; before declaring end-to-end sampling support,define eligible-token policy from explicit tokenizer/padding metadata or restrict unsupported mismatched-vocabulary sampling. Do not silently truncate head weights or assume every source-only row is padding.

Existing old engine likewise uses one packed token queue/PageTable; under inference mappings with position/seq/page unmapped,its logical packed stream/cache are replicated across those mesh axes. The proposed native boundary makes that restriction explicit rather than inventing independent data-axis schedulers. Actual old/new physical placement,extra gathers and replication bytes have not been measured; compare them before any efficiency claim. Data/FSDP sharding of stored weights is separate from replicated packed-stream computation.

LevanterHarnessLM.generate_until currently hardcodes BF16 cache dtype (eval_harness.py:867-880). Exercise it with a deliberately compatible BF16 native compute model; do not assume caller FP32 compute changes this existing cache setting. A wider dtype-policy change is a separate explicit decision.

verification_gates.evidence: On1CPU and4CPU explicit data2/model2,real tiny KvPageCache update+ragged calls verify complete shape/dtype/spec/device/memory/global-local-shard mapping,interleaved K/V values,unchanged padding slots,and round-trip output layout. Exercise existing engine shape sizing and actual allocation with same mapping. No mock or attribute-exists test.

Real identical native parameters compare packed prefill and successive decode logits against independent full causal native forward over each sequence. Reuse test_paged_attention.py:268-514 SequenceTable/PageTable fixtures: unequal lengths,reordered/non-dense slots,nonempty prefixes,chunk sizes crossing pages,one sequence with0new tokens and invalid tail padding. Compare valid logits and actual cache K/V; no cross-sequence leakage.

Small orthogonal cases for MHA/GQA,tied/untied head,FP32/BF16,page dtype and long absolute positions/default+scaled RoPE; preserve existing bias/norm flags through reused helpers. Reuse test_llama_native.py parameter imports and scaled-RoPE references. Report max/mean error and unchanged established tolerances; existing RPA tests permit CPU1e-4/TPU2e-2,which is only a paged-kernel test tolerance and does not relax campaign Trainer acceptance.

Offline tiny model+tokenizer through shared load boundary,InferenceEngine.generate and sample entrypoint: deterministic greedy sequence agrees with full causal reference,unequal prompts/chunked prefill,stop handling,multiple generations sharing a partial page,subsequent reset/reuse. Extend existing inference tests; current test_engine DummyModel tests do not establish native correctness. Assert copied partial-page writes do not alter parent and donated state is consumed once.

One offline tiny BF16 native model with real local tokenizer and existing _LmEvalHarnessWorker/LevanterHarnessLM,call generate_until on two unequal prompts requesting multiple new tokens plus a stop string. This invokes actual engine prefill and subsequent same.decode/cache state; compare greedy generated IDs/text against independent per-sequence causal reference and assert stop/context behavior. Do not mock engine/model decode or replace generate_until. Keep optional lm_eval dependency handling at established boundary. Pair with the direct engine test configured max_prefill_size small enough that prompt crosses a chunk/page and max_new_tokens>=2; this specifically prevents a prefill-only pass.

TPU-mark only actual accelerator/collective cases per TESTING.md. Separately authorized TPU test must demonstrate intended ragged kernel invocation,cache layout,numerical comparison and donated/alias behavior; fallback-only pass is reference evidence. No launch is authorized by this audit. CPU correctness does not establish throughput.

After focused behavioral tests,required infra/pre-commit.py,affected safe tests,pyrefly,and manage-pr review/publication workflow. Confirm ordinary forward/loss/gradient,H F import/export and checkpoint source identities unchanged by shared helper extraction. No new HBM/performance claim without matched measurement.

adoption_and_deletion: This slice closes standard-Llama paged generation only after tested shared loading and real sampling/eval callers work. Keep canonical llama registry/defaults unchanged during implementation; NativeLlama is transitional,not a permanent second standard-Llama runtime.

Once all canonical replacement gates pass,switch canonical Llama factories/defaults and migrate selected callers together. Remove old standard-Llama decode/cache traversal and old-only sampling assumptions rather than preserving two permanent loops. Engine,PageTable,SequenceTable,KvPageCache,ListCache and ragged kernel remain shared maintained infrastructure.

Do not alias Mistral,Qwen,Qwen3MoE,Apertus,Gemma,Mixtral,OLMo or OLMo3 to native dense Llama. Their existing old-Llama/config/MLP/embedding dependencies require explicit extraction/migration before old module deletion; family math and cache/mask semantics remain owned by those families.

Current failed large-model numerical acceptance,legacy full-state conversion and remaining migration coverage are independent gates. Generation support,even if passing,does not accept the rejected query-scale candidate,authorize Trainer/source adoption,or prove convergence/performance.
